tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i sgrub thabs ma nor don gsal bzhugs// na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ gsang gsum 'khor lo'i mgon po dbyer med pa'i/ /lnga phrag gsum ldan bdag med mkha' 'gro yi/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la gus btud nas/ /de yi sgrub thabs ma nor don gsal spel/ /de la 'dir rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i sgrub thabs yan lag drug pa bsgom par 'dod pas/ nub mo chos thams cad 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang du nyal/ tho rangs kyi thun la chu las nya ldang ba'i tshul du bdag med ma'i nga rgyal gyis langs te yi ge gsum gyis gnas gsum bsrung la/ bsam gtan gyi grogs su 'gro na dbang bskur bar bsam zhing khrus byas la/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bsam mo/ /de nas rdo rje'i glu bkris smon lam rnams byas la/ yod na bdud rtsi ril bu'am/ med na chang bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas 'bru gsum gyi lce la bzhag ste/ stan nang tshang can la bsam gtan gyi spyod lam gyis 'dug ste/ skyabs yul rnams gsal bar dmigs la/ ngag tu/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i zhes pa gsung rgyun yin/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes ci nus kyi mthar thal mo sbyar la/

bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ skyabs yul rnams rang la thim par bsam/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rang 'dra'i rigs bdag gi dbu rgyan can/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po de las 'od 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas hūm̐ las bdud rtsi babs/ he ru ka'i yab kyi gsung ba gsung rgyun yin/ sku gang / dbyibs brgyud yum gyi sku gang / yab yum gyi sku thams cad las bdud rtsi babs/ bdag gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs pas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu'am rnag khrag gi rnam pas gshang gci gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis nas thon nas shul thams cad bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra he ru ka te no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ ḍi d+dho me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/

a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+ta shrī yaṃ/ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wan badz+ra he ru ka ma me muñca/ badz+ra he ru ko3 bha wa/ mahā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūṃ phaṭ/ ces ci nus kyi mthar/ bla ma bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchis/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes pa dang ltung ba dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu ste spyi bo nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus 'ja' tshon ltar gyur/ rang skad cig gis gsung ba gsung rgyun yin/ skad cig gis rdo rje bdag med mar gsal ba'i snying khar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du am̐ sngon po de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi cha la bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pa can bzhugs pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ se gol dang rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na maḥshrī badz+ra he rat+ma maṇ+ḍal bh+yaḥ zhes pas phyag bya/ snying kha'i sa bon las spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsam la/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ /ro langs ma ni chu lag ma/ /ghasma ri ni sman 'dzin cing / /puk+ka si ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung / /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod/ /'dod chags chen pos rjes chags pas/ /g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /ces pas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/

/sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rje yid rangs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming gsang ming brjod 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas ni/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni bsdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por gzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ste/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas brtan por gzung / /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yis/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med mchog

/dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyis phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung / /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma phyung ba dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /ces lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces brjod/ oṃ shu n+yā ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje rwa nyi shu pa/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes lan gsum/ de lta bu'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su nang du gsung ba gsung rgyun yin e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ gdeng kha che ba gyen du bstan pa/ rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa/ de'i nang du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhung gdungs pa lta bu chang zung dang mchog ma la yaṃ dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po zur bzhir rdo rje phyed pa dang / lte ba la laṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du bh+rum̐ las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa bh+rum̐ gyis mtshan pa/

de'i steng gi bar snang la oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥdamar po gnyis kyis mtha' brten pa'i bar do'i rnam par shes pa de rnams 'byung bzhi 'khor lo dang bcas pa la thim ste thams cad ro gcig tu 'dres pa las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang 'phar ma gnyis dang bcas pa gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin nag po/ ljang khu/ dmar po/ ser po/ dkar po'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po la dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i steng du rin po che'i mda' yab dang pu shus brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol tu 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod par byed pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng rdo rje'i gdung zlum po/ de'i steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bris shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i steng du rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis brgyan pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng gi thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng du pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang / gdugs dang ri dwags dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang gos dang / 'phan dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang / rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs pa rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang du gyur/ de nas dur khrod kyi ngag 'don rgyas pa la dga' ba rnams yab kyis mngon bsgrub mchod kyi skabs su ngag 'don rgyas pa kho na mdzad/ rtogs yan lag drug pa bzhin bya'o/ /bsdu na/ de'i phyi rol tu dur khrod chen po brgyad/ de dag la gnas pa'i shing chen po brgyad/ shing gi rtsa ba la gnas pa'i phyogs skyong ba brgyad/ shing gi yal ga la gnas pa'i zhing skyong brgyad/ de dag gi nam mkha' la gnas pa'i sprin chen po brgyad/

de dag la gnas pa'i klu chen po brgyad/ gzhan yang ro mgo bo bcad pa dang / dpyangs pa dang / bsnyal ba dang / gsal shing gis phug pa dang / mgo bo dang / keng rus dang / ce spyang dang / khwa dang / 'ug pa dang / bya rgod dang / ro langs rnams phaiṃ zhes bya ba'i sgra sgrog par byed pa ma lus pa rnams kyang sngon gyi grub pa thob pa rnams kyi mngon par rtogs pa ste/ gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / yi dwags dang / sha za dang / smyo byed dang / brjed byed dang / mkha' 'gro dang / mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang / chu brgyad/ me brgyad/ mchod rten brgyad/ sgrub pa po rnams dang bcas pa'i dur khrod kyis yongs su bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi nang gi 'phar ma gnyis pa'i/ lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus sngon po'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i mu khyud la rdo rje rwa ba dang / 'od zer phreng bas bskor ba'i dbus dang phyogs bzhir nyi ma dang ro'i gdan re re/ phyi'i phyogs mtshams brgyad/ gtso mo'i 'og dang steng rnams su pad+ma dang / nyi ma dang ro'i gdan re re dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ni la ya badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ gdan bco lnga'i steng du sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo skar ma'i rnam pa lta bu'i/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ āḥ phrag gnyis brjod/ zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bco lngar gyur pa me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i bdag nyid mar me'i phreng ba lta bu'i/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ ya ra la wa ḍa dha/ phrag gnyis brjod/ zhu ba las byung ba nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bco lngar gyur pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de rnams kyi bar du rim pa bzhin du/ aṃ āṃ/ iṃ īṃ/ uṃ ūṃ/

ṛṃ ṝṃ/ l̥ṃ l̥̄ṃ/ eṃ aiṃ/ oṃ auṃ/ aṃ rnams las gri gug sngo nag bco lnga'i yu ba la aṃ āṃ/ sogs nas/ aṃ rnams kyis mtshan pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ nyi zla phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres pa bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes/ de las yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i skur gyur pa ni/ dbus su rang nyid rdo rje bdag med ma/ shar du rdo rje ma/ lhor gsang ba'i dkar mo/ nub tu chu'i rnal 'byor ma/ byang du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ phyi'i 'phar ma phyi ma'i zhes pa gsung rgyun la yod pa gnas ma la/ byang shar du puk+ka sī/ shar lhor ri khrod ma/ lho nub tu gdol pa mo/ nub byang du g.yung mo/ shar du gau rī/ lhor tsau rī/ nub tu bet+ta li/ byang du ghasma ri/ 'og tu sa spyod ma/ steng du mkha' spyod ma ste lha mo thams cad sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ nu 'bur zung gis mdzes pa/ smin mtshams su khro gnyer bsdus pa/ cung zad 'dzum zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug 'phyar te 'dzin cing / g.yon pa bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar bsnams pa/ g.yon pa'i gru mo na kha ṭ+waṃ la dril bu dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan cing / stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yon pa'i mthil gyis ro'i steng du mnan cing / skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /lha de thams cad ces pa gsung rgyun rnams kyi thugs khar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du rang rang gi sa bon/ aṃ āṃ/ iṃ īṃ/ uṃ ūṃ/ ṛṃ ṝṃ/ l̥ṃ l̥̄ṃ/ eṃ aiṃ oṃ auṃ/ am̐ rnams las gri gug sngo nag bco lnga'i yu ba la/

aṃ āṃ/ iṃ īṃ/ uṃ ūṃ/ ṛṃ ṝṃl̥ṃ l̥ṃ/ eṃ aiṃ/ oṃ auṃ/ am̐ rnams kyis mtshan pa de rnams las 'od zer 'phros pa phyi snod kyi 'jig rten la phog pas gzhal yas khang dang / nang bcud kyi sems can la phog pas lha mo bco lnga'i skur gyur/ de thams cad kyi mig tu mam̐ las gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ rna bar dam̐ las zhe sdang rdo rje ma sngon mo/ snar pam̐ las ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ khar ram̐ las 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ dpral bar am̐ las phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang khu/ snying khar nam̐ las bdag med rnal 'byor ma nag mo/ spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje ma dkar mo/ mgrin pa āḥlas gsung rdo rje ma dmar mo/ thugs kar hūm̐ las thugs rje ma nag mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma gri gug dang thod pa kha ṭ+waṃ ga 'dzin pa/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang / mi mgo skam po'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ ro'i gdan la skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /rang gi thugs ka'i aṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas rje btsun lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ se gol dang rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas spyan drangs/ dkar mo ri dgas sogs kyis mchod/ 'gro ba bud med 'dul gzigs nas/ /bdag med rnal 'byor mar gyur gang / /phyag 'tshal pha rol phyin thub la/ /sgyu ma'i phyag rgyas phyag 'tshal bstod/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī akar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra tsau rī pra bh+ya sha ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra bait+ta li ban+dha baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma ri wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ sngags 'di rnams kyi phyag rgya yab kyi skabs bzhin bya'o/ /gnyis su med par thim pa'i rkyen gyis skad cig gis rang gi lus rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje/ rkang mthil rdo rje'i sa gzhi/

rtsibs logs zhes pa gsung rgyun/ ma rdo rje'i rwa ba/ pags pa rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ ba spu mda'i drwa ba/ sen mo skra sen zhes pa gsung rgyun/ me ri 'bar ba ste srung ba'i 'khor lo dang / rkang mthil rlung / sum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ snying kha sa/ rgal tshigs ri rab/ mgo bo ri rab kyi stod kyi cha/ lus mi mnyam pa med pa gru bzhi gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ snying kha nas 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba'i rtsa'i bu kha bzhi ni sgo bzhi/ mig pañca re ga sna rin po che pha gu/ so drwa ba dra phyed/ lce mchu 'dod yon gyi snam bu/ rna ba rta babs/ rkang rnams ka ba brgyad de rten gyi dkyil 'khor dang / snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus dang phyogs kyi rtsa bzhi sdom pa rdo rje bdag med ma/ spyi bo dang spyi gtsug tu rdo rje ma/ rna ba g.yas pa dang ltag par gsang ba'i dkar mo/ rna ba g.yon pa dang smin ma'i dbus su chu'i rnal 'byor ma/ mig gnyis dang phrag pa gnyis su rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ mchan khung gnyis dang nu ma gnyis su puk+ka sī/ lte ba dang sna rtser sha wa ri/ kha dang mgrin par tsaṇ+ḍa lī/ snying kha dang 'dom par ḍom+bhi ni/ mtshan ma dang gshang lam du gau rī/ brla gnyis dang byin pa gnyis su tsau rī/ sor mo bcu drug dang bol gong gnyis su bait+ta lī/ spyi bo spyi gtsug tu ni rdo rje ma/ /rna g.yas ltag par gsang ba'i dkar mo dang / /rna g.yon smin mtshams chu'i rnal 'byor ma/ /mig gnyis dpung gnyis rdo rje mkha' 'gro ste/ /mchan khung gnyis dang nu gnyis puk+ka si/ /lte ba dang ni ltag tser sha wa ri/ /kha dang mgrin par tsuṇ+ṭa li gnas shing / /snying kha 'dom gyi bar du ḍom+bhi ni/ /rtags dang bshang ba'i lam du gau ri gnas/ /brla gnyis byin pa gnyis su tsau ri ma/ /sor mo rnams dang bol gong bait+ta li/ /mthe bong bzhi dang pus gnyis ghasma ri/ /rtsa brgyad mdun gyi mtshams gnyis mkha' spyod ma/

/snying kha'i phyogs kyi rtsa bzhi gtso mor gnas/ /sku mdog phyag mtshan phyi yi tshul dang mthun/ /rtsa ni lus kyi dkyil 'khor gsal ba 'o/ /yi ge bha ga'i dkyil 'khor snying khar hūm̐/ /aṃ gi bar du byas pa'i rtsa dgu ste/ /spyi bo dag nas pus mo'i bar dag tu/ /pu dza o a go ra de ma dang / /ka o tri ko ka la ka hi dang / /pre gri sū+o su na sī ma ku dang / /hūm̐ bzhi dang bcas bha ga'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /zhes chos rje bla ma dam pa'i gsung rab las 'byung ba yin lags/ mthe bong gnyis dang pus mo gnyis su ghasma ri/ snying kha'i phyi bskor gyi mdun dang g.yas su mkha' spyod ma/ rgyab dang g.yon du sa spyod ma ste lha mo thams cad kyang sku mdog nag mo sogs gong bzhin brjod/ snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su hūm̐ aṃ yi ge rnam pa can/ phyogs bzhir hūm̐ ring po bzhi/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su pu dza/ o a/ gau ra de ma/ ka o/ tri ko ka la ka hi/ pre gṛ/ so su/ na sī ma ku'i dbyibs can gnas pa rnams rtsa yi ge'i dkyil 'khor/ de dag gi nang na gnas pa'i khams rnams ni bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor/ rlung rnams ni snying po ye shes rlung gi dkyil 'khor ste rang gi lus sku bzhi'i rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ta badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i dbang gi lha rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug khro bo bcu dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥdakar mo ri dwags sogs nas/ /g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ kyis mchod/ zhe sdang rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gti mug rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ser sna rdo rje bdag la gsol/ /'dod chags rdo rje bdag la skyobs/ /yid dang phrag dog chen po kun/

/rdo rje kun gyi dam tshig mchog /las rnams thams cad sgrub byed pa/ /rdo rje can kun bdag dges mdzod/ /ces pas bstod/ dbang lha'i mdun du pad zla'i gdan la dbang rdzas rnams kyang yod par bsam la cho ga rnams bla mas mdzad cing / dbang rdzas rnams de'i thugs ka nas bye ba'i he ru kas gnang bar bsam mo/ /oṃ badz+ra bhū mi sogs ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la rdo rje slob ma'i dbang zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /lan gsum/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho?&haṃ/ bdag gi rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las gnyis ka'ang mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum ma mā ki sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ spyi bor sku rdo rje ma/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje ma/ thugs khar thugs rdo rje ma/ thugs kha'i hūm̐ thugs kha'i sa bon las zhes pa gsung rgyun yin/las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mi bskyod pa yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ 'di la thugs kha'i sa bon las byas kyang rung zhing /

'og ma rnams dang yang 'gre'o/ /skabs 'di'i bsgom don ni sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i lam dus kyi dbang gi yi ge las/ rigs lnga'i ye shes pa spyan 'dren gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang lha'i gtso bo nyid yin pas/ hūm̐ 'ba' zhig legs te gtso bo go mi 'pho ba mi bskyod pa kyai rdo rje kho na yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yang rigs lnga so so'i sa bon brjod na gtso bo go 'pho dgos te de bzhin gyi go sa ma chags pa rnams dbang lha'i gtso bo zur du bzhag pa'i rang gi thugs kha'i hūm̐ am̐ sogs la bsam nas byed pa de 'khrul tshabs chen por 'gro yin 'dug pas gong bzhin brjod pa legs pas shes ldan kun gyis dgongs gzhigs 'jug pa gal che'o/ /zhes gsungs shing / lam dus kyi yi ge de na thugs kha'i hūm̐ las gsung ba yang yod pa dang / gzhan yang gong ma'i gsung rab kun tu 'di 'dra ba kho na gsungs pas nyams len pa rnams stabs 'gros kyi hol spyod spangs nas zhib cha la zhib tu gzigs pa zhu 'tshal/ gsung rab kyi go ba gang yang ma chags pa'i slob dpon gyi long ba 'khar 'dzugs kyi ngag rgyun la snying po med pas bzhi mdo'i rtswa bzhin du 'dor bar bya'o/ /gau ri sogs dang / dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing dbang rdzas dbang rdzas la dbang bskur zhes pa gsung rgyun yin/ kyi lha'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi mi bskyod pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ bcom ldan de bzhin sogs nas/ stsol ces gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni sogs nas/ chen po sbyin/ /oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/

rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa dang bcas te dbang bskur bas/ dbang gi chu rgyun des smin mtshams yan chad gang / bum pa'i dbang thob/ mgrin pa yan chad gang / gsang ba'i dbang thob/ snying kha yan chad gang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ lus thams cad gang / mchog tu bde ba chen po bzhi ba'i dbang thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra a lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi t+ya āḥhūm̐/ de ltar na mi bskyod pa'i sgo nas chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i sa bon rgyud bag chags dang sa bon ma lus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /zhes thams cad la sbyor bar mdzad pa bdag 'jug bzhin mdzad do/ /la bzhag pa yin no/ /oṃ swa bhā wa nas/ hūṃ/ bdag gi tshor ba'i phung po dang / dbang rdzas dbu rgyan mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du am̐ las rin po che am̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las gnyis ka'ang rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rin po che dang / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje sogs nas/ thugs rdo rje/ thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gau rī sogs dang /

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lan gcig de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la sogs nas/ stsal du gsol/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa nas/ hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing dbang rdzas kyi lha'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbur brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dbu rgyan du gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni sogs nas/ phyag byas pa'i/ /rin chen dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /oṃ badz+ra rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñca mi/ badz+ra ra ga ta badz+ra sha li hoḥ zhes gsungs shing cod pan bcings/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa nas/ hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar ma lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas/ nai wi t+ya āḥhūm̐/ de ltar na rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sgo nas cod pan gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dag tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /oṃ swa bhā wa nas/ haṃ/ bdag gi 'du shes kyi phung po dang / dbang rdzas rdo rje mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du dz+riṃ las pad+ma dz+riṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ gnyis ka'ang 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pad+ma dang / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa yum gos dkar mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje sogs nas/ thugs rdo rje ma/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'od dpag med yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥgau rī sogs dang /

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lan gcig de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la sogs nas/ stsal du gsol/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa nas/ hūm̐ zhes gsungs shing dbang rdzas kyi lha'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi 'od dpag med yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rdo rjer gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs nas/ stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis longs/ /oṃ mahā badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing rdo rje byin te/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa nas/ hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas/ nai wi d+ya āḥhūm̐/ de ltar na 'od dpag med kyi sgo nas rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'dod chags dag 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ 'od dpag med kyi sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /oṃ swa bhā wa nas/ haṃ/ bdag gi 'du byed kyi phung po dang dbang rdzas dril bu mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ kham̐ las ral gri kham̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ gnyis ka'ang don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ral gri g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum dam tshig gi sgrol ma ljang khu gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ sogs nas/ thugs rdo rje ma/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad don yod grub yab yum kyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

gau rī sogs dang / dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lan gcig de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la sogs nas/ stsal du gsol/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa nas/ hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing dbang rdzas kyi lha'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi don yod grub pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dril bur gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs nas/ stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ra a ti pa ti satwaṃ/ a bhi ṣiñca mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes gsungs shing dril bu byin te/ oṃ badz+ra bhā wa nas/ hūm̐ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas/ nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ de ltar na don yod grub pa'i sgo nas dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog dag 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur/ bya ba bsgrub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ don yod grub pa'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /oṃ swa bhā wa nas/ ham̐/ bdag gi gzugs kyi phung po mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du bh+rum̐ las 'khor lo bh+rum̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ sogs nas/ thugs rdo rje ma/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rnam par snang mdzad yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gau rī sogs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sogs nas/ stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/

oṃ badz+ra satwa satwaṃ mam̐ a bhi ṣiñca mi badz+ra na ma a bhi ṣe ka ta kye/ dpal che ge mo rang gi gsang mtshan brjod/ rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs shing ming btags te/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa nas/ hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas/ nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ de ltar na rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgo nas ming gi dbang thob/ gti mug dag gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ chos dbyings ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /dngos kun gang dang gang snang ba/ /gtso de rang gi lhag pa'i lha/ /chos rnams rang bzhin rnyog med dag /sangs rgyas ye shes blta bar gyis/ /oṃ swa bha wa nas/ ham̐/ bdag gi phung po lnga'i chos nyid la tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag gi phung po lnga'i chos nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ sogs nas/ thugs rdo rje ma/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum kyis rnam par om̐ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gau rī sogs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa nas/ hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/

'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag na gnas/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bzung / /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa mā ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa twaṃ dha ra ya mi badz+ra satwa hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung cig lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du/ sogs brjod/ mi ldog 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba/ /mgon pos bdag la stsal nas kyang / /'khor lo lha yi de nyid dang / /slob dpon 'phrin las yongs su bzung / /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang / /sdom pa'ang bla na med pa stsol/ /lan gsum/ 'di de sogs nas/ hūm̐/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag pos bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu la'o/ oṃ mahā badz+ra hūm̐/ rang gi sems nges don gyi rdo rje yin snyam du bsam/ /'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /dril bu'i sgra kun rjes shes rab dbyangs kyi zhes gsungs/ 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zungs/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /āḥ/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis bdag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pa/ /srid pa dam par byed par 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe āḥ rang gi ngag nges don gyi dril bu yin no snyam du bsam/ rang nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog dkar po sogs snga ma ltar las/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje 'chang chen po yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gau rī/ yang na/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥshes rab bcu drug lon pa la/ /lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba/

/slob dpon gyi ni dbang du brjod/ /rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zungs shig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar bgyi/ /srid pa'i bde ba shin tu chung / /sdu bsngal chen po 'dag bya'i phyir/ /shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs/ /dam tshig 'di ni khyod kyis longs/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /ci 'dod pa ni bsten bzhin du/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lha'i sbyor bas/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par bgyi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /'da' ba ru ni mi mdzad pa'i/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig ces su grags/ /yid kyi lus ni brtan phyir ro/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /zhes sogs mi bskyod pa chu dbang ltar las/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje 'chang chen pos dbur brgyan/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swahā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas/ nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ de ltar na bla ma'i sku'i dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag lam bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi sogs nas/ bla ma dam pa la gsang dbang zhu ba'i yon du sogs dang / khyod ni rnal 'byor ma sogs nas/ yid kyis dges/ zhes brjod/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa/ /mi phyed phyag rgya bsgrub pa po/ /rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung / /ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che/ /mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod/ /'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs/ /lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig ras bcings bar bsam/ bla ma he ru ka lus dkyil gyi lha dang bcas pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i thig le bdag gi lce thog tu bzhag ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar/ /bdag gis gsang ba'i dbang gis ni/

/sems kyi rgyun gyis dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥthig le mgrin pa nas 'phel te gang bas gsal stong gi ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes par gyur par bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig ras phye bar bsam/ de ltar na rdzas gsang ba byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag lam tsaṇ+ḍa li bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi sogs nas/ 'di nyid shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du/ sogs brjod/ khyod ni rnal 'byor sogs nas yid kyis dges/ zhes dang / bcom ldan zhi ba sogs nas/ bdag la skyobs/ lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig ras bcings par bsam/ bla mas/ dga' ster gnas ster lha mo ni/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma/ /khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che/ /khyer la mchod pa dag tu gyis/ /zhes gsung zhing phyag rgya ma zhig bdag la gtad de/ des bdag la/ gshang gci dag ni za ba dang / /phrag dang khu ba de bzhin du/ /sha chen brten par bu spro 'am/ /bud med rnams la rtag gus dang / /bha ga'i pad+mor 'o byed par/ /bu khyod ci dgar spro gyur tam/ /zhes dri pa la bdag gis/ /gshang gci dag ni za ba dang / /khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te/ /sha chen bsten par cis mi spro/ /bu med rnams la rtag gus dang / /bha ga'i pad+mor 'o byed par/ /bdag nyid ci dgar spro gyur to/ /zhes lan btab pas/ e ma nga yi pad+ma 'di/ /bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /gal te cho ga bzhin bsten na/ /de yi mdun na bdag 'dug ste/ /sangs rgyas bsnyen pa la sogs pa/ /pad+mar bya ba ji bzhin byed/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid de/ /'di nyid du ni rtag tu zhugs/ /blun po gang zhig 'di spong ba/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /satwaṃ pad+ma bhañja mok+ṣa hoḥzhes gsungs shing bdag gi pang du byon par bsam la/ rang nyid he ru ka'i nga rgyal du 'phos/

rig ma bdag med mar gsal ba'i mkha' āḥlas pad+ma āḥyis mtshan pa dang / rang nyid kyai rdo rje lus dkyil gyi lha dang bcas par gsal ba'i gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa snyoms par zhugs pa'i rjes chags kyi mes spyi bo'i haṃ zhu ba'i byang chub kyi sems spyi bo nas mgrin par byon pas dga' ba/ snying khar byon pas mchog dga'/ lte bar byon pas dga' bral/ mkha' gsang gi rtser byang sems dkar dmar 'dzom pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ slar rlung gi nus pas byang sems yar drangs te/ lte bar byon pas dga' ba/ snying khar byon pas mchog dga'/ mgrin par byon pas dga' bral/ spyi bor byon pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas par bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig ras phye/ de ltar na phyag rgya bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ sems kyi dri ma dag pho nya'i lam bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu chos sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi sogs nas/ 'di nyid dbang bzhi pa zhu ba'i yon du/ sogs brjod/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ /dbang bskur gsum po bdag la gnang / /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /bzhi pa yang ni byin gyis rlobs/ /lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig ras bcings par bsam/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing / /rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ /rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid/ /khyod rang yang ni de yi pha/ /zhes gsungs par bsam ste/ de yi don rang nyid lus dkyil gyi lha dang bcas pa snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu'i sku can du snang ba sprul sku/ sems rgyud phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyar ba las byung ba'i bde chen gyi rnam par shar ba longs sku/ lha sku bde chen gyi rnam par snang tsam de nyid skye 'gag gnas gsum thams cad dang bral ba chos sku/ de gsum ngo bo dbyer mi phyed pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste mdor na sems kyi gshis ci yang ma yin pa/

gdangs bde chen du ma 'gags pa/ rtsal lha skur 'char ba/ bsgom bya sgom byed las 'das pa nam mkha' lta bur shes par byas la 'dzin med du bzhag oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig ras phye/ de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag lam rdo rje'i rba rlabs bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ /lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi sogs nas/ 'di nyid dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la dbang yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu dbul bar bgyi'o/ /sogs brjod/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ /khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ /khyod kyi slob mar bzung ba dang / /cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol/ /lan gsum brjod/ mdun gyi dbang lha rnams 'od du zhu/ phyi nang gi lha thams cad kyi spyi bo nas thim pas dbang gi chu rgyun des lus thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag dbang thams cad thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ rdo rje ma la rnam par snang mdzad/ gsang ba'i dkar mo la rin chen 'byung ldan/ chu'i rnal 'byor ma la 'od dpag med/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la don yod grub pa/ gau rī dang puk+ka la mi bskyod pa/ tsau ri dang sha wa ri la rnam par snang mdzad/ bait+ta li dang tsaṇ+ḍa li la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ghasma ri dang ḍom+bhi ni la 'od dpag med/ sa spyod ma la rnam par snang mdzad/ mkha' spyod ma la 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3ham̐/ zhes brjod/ bdud rtsi dngos su 'byor ram bsams kyang rung ste/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/

stong pa'i ngang las 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu gdungs pa lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du shar du go las ba lang gi sha lhor ku las khyi'i sha nub tu da las rta'i sha byang du ha las glang po che'i sha dbus su na las mi'i sha sha de rnams re re'i steng du yang bdud rtsi lnga lnga yod pa ni shar du bh+rum̐ las dri chen/ lhor am̐ las rak+ta/ nub tu dz+riṃ las byang sems/ byang du kham̐ las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ dbus su hūm̐ las dri chu/ de rnams kyi steng du shar du bh+rum̐ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ lhor am̐ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ nub tu dz+riṃ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ byang du kham̐ bya ba bsgrub pa'i ye shes/ dbus su hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ zla ba'i mthar g.yon bskor du/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ āḥ g.yas bskor gyis/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po mgo thur du bltas pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ rdo rje lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pa rlung gi ba dan la phog pas rlung g.yos/ me sbar bas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga rnams skol zhing 'od du zhu ba'i rlangs pa gyen la song bas/ oṃ dang rdo rje lte ba'i hūm̐ la phog pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag yang hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kha nas yang dag pa'i bdud rtsi rnams he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par byon te/

rdo rje lte ba'i hūm̐ la thim pas rdo rje ljid dang ldan par gyur/ rdo rje nyi ma oṃ dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du lhung ba 'od du zhu nas sngar gyi bdud rtsi rnams dang gnyis su med par gyur te kha dog dang dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhriḥ zhes lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs pa g.yon pa'i srin lag gis blangs te myang la/ lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gsol bas bde bas tshim par bsam ste/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swa da na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ rang gi snying kha nas sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsam zhing / dkar mo ri dwags/ sogs nas/ 'khyud pa nyid/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu dza badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ lha mo rnams kyis bstod par bsam zhing / 'gro ba bud med 'dul gzigs nas/ /sogs gong bzhin brjod la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti ta badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pa de yan chad rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod par bsgom la/ rten dang brten par bcas pa snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu la sems cung zad bzung / de nas kha dog gi sgo nas zhen pa spang ba'i phyir lha mo thams cad dang por nag po/ gnyis par dmar po/ gsum par ser po/ bzhi bar ljang khu/ lnga par sngon po/ drug par dkar po/ bdun par phyed dkar phyed nag brgyad par re re'ang kha dog drug ldan du bsgom/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ rang rje btsun rdo rje bdag med mar gsal ba'i lus kyi nang phru ma phus btab pa lta bu dmar seng nge ba'i dbus lte ba nas spyi bo'i bar la a wa dhu ti ste/ dbu ma kha dog dmar ser/ de'i g.yas su ro ma dmar po me'i rang bzhin kha dog dmar smug g.yon du rkyang ma dkar po chu'i rang bzhin kha dog dkar po ste gsum ka gro sog 'bring po tsam gsal gdab/ de nas a wa dhu ti la brten pa'i lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi ni a wa dhu ti las phyogs bzhir kha sog ma'i sbug 'dra bar re gyes/

bzhi po de las gnyis gnyis su gyes/ brgyad po de las gnyis gnyis su gyes/ bcu drug po de las gnyis gnyis su gyes/ sum cu so gnyis po de las gnyis gnyis su gyes pas drug cu rtsa bzhi'o/ /de'i lte ba dbu ma'i mas snar aṃ dmar po dbu can gyi shad lta bu'i rnam pas klad kor dbu ma'i nang du chud pa me'i rang bzhin kha dog dmar ser mgo gyen du bstan pa/ nang bskor gyi rtsa sbug brgyad kyi rtse mor mdun nas brtsams te/ a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha phyi'i rtsa 'dab sog sbug 'dra ba'i drug cu rtsa bzhi'i rtse mo nas brtsams te g.yon skor du a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ ā/ tshar gnyis kyis bskor ba mgo gyen du bstan pa kha dog dmar ser/ mdun nas brtsams te g.yas bskor du/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa/ zhes pa ha dang k+ṣa gnyis spangs pas bskor ba'i yig 'bru rnams kha dog dmar ser mgo gyen bstan/ de bzhin du snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad kyis bskor ba'i rtsa sbug gyes lugs lte ba'i nang skor dang 'dra ba'i dbus su hūm̐ sngon po mgo thur du bstan pa/ phyogs bzhir bh+rum̐ am̐ dz+riṃ kham̐/ mtshams bzhir lam̐ mam̐ pam̐ tam̐ rnams kha dog sngon po mgo thur bstan/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug pa'i rtsa sbug gyes lugs gong lte ba dang 'dra ba'i dbu ma'i dbus su oṃ dmar po mgo gyen du bstan pa/ 'dab ma'i rtsa sbug gi rtse mor a l̥ ste dbyangs yig bcu drug kha dog dmar po mgo gyen bstan g.yon bskor du yod pa/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi rtsa sbug gyes lugs lte ba'i nang bskor dang 'dra ba'i dbus/ dbu ma'i yas sner haṃ dkar po mgo thur bstan/ klad kor dbu ma'i nang du chud pa 'dab ma sum cu so gnyis la g.yon bskor du a ā sogs dbyangs yig bcu drug g.yas bskor du ka kha ga gha nga /

nas ta'i bar te bcu drug rnams kha dog dkar po mgo thur bstan bsam/ bshang sgor rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ sum mdor me'i dkyil 'khor bsgom/ de nas rlung ro lan gsum bus nas 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum gyi sbyor ba lan gsum byas pa'i tha ma la bsdams pas bshang sgo'i rlung g.yos/ sum mdo'i me sbar te lte ba'i aṃ la bsnun pas aṃ las me shin tu ches phra ba g.yas ro ma nas song / lte ba'i rtsa 'khor gyi nang nas bskor rtsa nang gi ljan ljin dang / yig 'bru'i mi gtsang bar snang ba rnams bsregs te cung zad sreb par bsam/ de bzhin yang ro ma nas song / snying kha'i 'dab ma'i yig 'bru rnams gong bzhin bsregs/ yang ro ma nas song / mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab kyi yig 'bru rnams bsregs/ yang ro ma nas song / spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab kyi yig 'bru rnams bsregs te haṃ la bsnun pas haṃ las byang sems dkar po babs pa g.yon rkyang ma nas song / spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor gyi 'dab ma'i rtsa sbug rnams khengs te shel dwangs ma dang 'dra bar byas/ yig 'bru rnams sngar bas gsal zhing 'od dang ldan par byas/ yang g.yon rkyang ma nas song mgrin pa'i rtsa dang yig 'bru rnams gong bzhin gsos btab/ yang rkyang ma nas song / snying kha'i rtsa 'dab dang yig 'bru rnams gong bzhin gsos btab/ yang rkyang ma nas song / lte ba'i rtsa 'dab dang yig 'bru rnams gsos btab ste/ lte ba'i aṃ la phog yang me 'bar te g.yas ro ma nas song ba sogs sngar dang 'dra ba'i 'bar 'dzag lan gsum bar bsgoms nas tha ma g.yon rkyang ma nas byang sems dkar po aṃ la phog pas sngar bas ches 'bar zhing shin tu tsha bas dbu ma'i mas sna kha phye ste yar byon/ snying kha'i hūm̐ dang mgrin pa'i oṃ bcom/ me yar song dbu ma'i yas sna phye ste haṃ la phog pas de zhu ste byang chub kyi sems shin tu dkar ba cher babs te mu tig gi phreng ba'am/ dar dkar gyi skud pa lta bur dbu ma'i nang na mar song ste mgrin pa'i oṃ dang snying kha'i hūm̐ gsos btab pa gong dang 'dra/

byang sems dkar po mar byon/ lte ba'i aṃ la phog pas slar me 'bar te sngar bzhin 'bar 'dzag bsam pa 'dra bas lte ba'i gong sor bzhi tsam du sems gtad la rlung bus te steng rlung mnan/ 'og rlung bskums te lte bar kha sbyar rlung bum pa can bzung / de lta bu'i rlung sbyor lan gsum tsam bya ba ste rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /dag pa dran pa ni/ gzhal yas khang pa ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun gyi ngo bo yin la/ de yang rang gi sems rnam par dag pa'o/ /zhes rten gyi dag pa dang / gzugs phung rdo rje ma yin te/ /tshor ba la yang dkar mor brjod/ /'du shes chu yi rnal 'byor ma/ /'du byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /rnam shes phung po'i tshul gyis ni/ /bdag med rnal 'byor ma gnas so/ /zhe sdang zhes bshad rdo rje ma/ /'dod chags chu yi rnal 'byor ma/ /phrag dog rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /ser sna gsang ba'i dkar mo nyid/ /gti mug de bzhin rdo rjer bshad/ /sa ni puk+ka sī zhes bshad/ /chu khams rngon pa ma zhes brjod/ /me ni gtum mor shes par bya/ /rlung ni g.yung mor rab tu grags/ /gzugs la gau rir rtag tu bshad/ /sgra la chom rkun ma rab grags/ /dri yi cha la ro langs ma/ /ro la ghasma ri rab grags/ /reg la sa spyod ma zhes brjod/ /chos kyi dbyings la mkha' spyod ma/ /zhes lha'i dag pa dang / mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ /rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ /sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ /kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ /lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ /zhes dbang po'i dag pa dang / nga rgyal la sogs skyon drug rnams/ /gcod phyir gri gug rnam par 'dzin/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam rtog gis/ /mgo bo pad+ma'i snod du ni/ /bdud rnams rnam pa bzhi yi khrag /dngos grub phyir ni btung bar bya/ /stong pa'i rnam pas kha ṭ+waṃ ga /thabs ni ro ni rnam par dag /ces phyag mtshan gyi dag pa dang /

spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa/ /rna cha'i bdag nyid 'od dpag med/ /mgul gyi phreng ba rin chen bdag /lag par rnam par snang mdzad brjod/ /ske rags la ni don yod gnas/ /yan lag kun la rdor 'dzin mgon/ /zhes rgyan cha'i dag pa rnams dran par bya'o/ /de nas skabs 'dir oṃ pa de pa de sogs phreng ba byin rlabs kyi sngags lan gsum tsam re brjod pa yab kyi bzlas pa'i dus kyi phyag len bzhin bya'o/ /bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi snying khar nyi ma'i steng du am̐ sngon po las sngags kyi phreng ba byung ste lte ba nas thon nas zhal du zhugs te thugs ka'i am̐ la thim pa'i tshul gyis tshur 'khor gyi rnam pa'am/ zhal nas byung ste lte bar zhugs te am̐ la mas yar thim pa'i tshul gyis phar 'khor gyi rnam pas bzlas pa gang rung ngo / /de yang bsnyen pa dang zhi ba'i las bsgrub na sngags rnams kha dog dkar po'o/ /rgyas pa la ni ser po'o/ /dbang la dmar po'o/ /drag po la nag 'o/ /de la sngags ni bsdus pa la spro na/ oṃ āḥ a ā a 'di bzlas pa'i skabs su ma chad pa dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan de nyid lnga spel dgos par bshad cing / lhag par rje btsun rin po che'i mngon rtogs su gsungs pa ltar/ rjes 'jug gi yig cha tshad ldan kun las bshad pas ma chad pa gal che'o/ /i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes bzla bar bya'o/ /rgyas pa la dga' ba rnams ni/ oṃ āḥ am̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swahā/ zhes gtso mo dang / oṃ āḥ am̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swahā/ zhes rdo rje ma dang / oṃ āḥ iṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes gsang ba'i dkar mo dang / oṃ āḥ īṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swahā/ zhes chu'i rnal 'byor ma dang / oṃ āḥ um̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swahā/ zhes rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang / oṃ āḥ ūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes puk+ka sī dang / oṃ āḥ ṛṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes sha ba ri dang / oṃ āḥ ṝṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes gdol pa mo dang /

oṃ āḥ l̥ṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes g.yung mo dang / oṃ āḥ l̥̄ṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes gau rī dang / oṃ āḥ eṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes tsau rī dang / oṃ āḥ aiṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes bait+ta li dang / oṃ āḥ oṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes ghasma ri dang / oṃ āḥ auṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes sa spyod ma dang / oṃ āḥ aṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes mkha' spyod ma'o/ /gtso mo la brgya rtsa/ 'khor rnams la ji ltar rigs par bzla/ dmigs pa 'khor sngags dus rang rang gi sngags 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can rnams la phog pas sdig sgrib sbyangs te lha mo rnams kyi skur gyur par mos/ 'od zer gyi sna las mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab spros nas bla ma yi dam sogs 'phags pa rnams mchod pas mnyes te mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam pas rang gi snying khar thim pas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsams/ bzlas pa bsdu ba dang thal mo sbyar la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can la byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen mchog gi dngos grub rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma'i go 'phangs thob par byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ zhes brjod cing phreng ba rang gi spyi bor bzhag yig brgya lan gsum brjod pa gsung rgyun/ de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ de dur khrod brgyad la thim/ de 'khor gyi lha mo rnams la thim/ de gtso mo la thim/ zhes brjod cing bsam la/ de nas srod thun ma yin pa'i gtor ma dang 'brel na de'i rjes dang / de ma yin pa'i dkyil 'khor bsdu ba grub rjes/ kol+la e ṭi a bo la/ mum+mu ṇi re kak+ko la/ gha ṇe kri pi ta ho badz+dza i/ ka ru ṇi ki a o na ro lā/

ta hī ba la khadz+dza i/ gwa ḍeṃ ma a ṇa bidz+dza i/ ha le ka liñja ra pa ṇi a i/ dun du ra bādz+dza a i/ tsa u sa ma kats+tshu ri sih+la/ ka pu ra la i a i/ ma la in+dha na sa liñja/ ta hiṃ bha ru ṣa i a i/ phaiṃ kha ṇa kha ṭa ka ran+te/ shud+dha a shud+dha na mu ṇa a i/ ni raṃ su aṃ ge tsa ḍa wi/ ta heṃ dza sa ra ba pa ṇi a i/ ma la a dze kun du ru ba ṭa i/ ḍan+ḍi ma ta hi nan badz+dza a i/ zhes rdo rje'i glu blangs/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan snga ba/ /de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkris dang po yin/ /de yis nye bar bsten pa'i mchog ni mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa yin/ /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyi mchod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa yin/ /zhes bkra shis brjod/ rigs su skyes dang dam tshig can/ /smyo med kye yi rdo rje ston/ /bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol/ /zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang / /btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par/ /gang gi lam gyis grol gyur pa/ /de yis sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces smon lam btab/ spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe/ rang rdo rje bdag med mar gsal ba'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs/ skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa'i mthar/ 'gro ba thams cad rdo rje bdag med ma'i ngo bor rnam par dag pa yin no/

/zhes dang / dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i/ /sogs smon lam dang bkra shis rgyas par byas la/ rang gtso mo'i nga rgyal gyis spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor rgyas par byed na/ mig la gti mug rdo rje mar byin gyis brlabs/ yul gzugs la sogs par gau rir byin gyis brlabs/ mig gis gzugs mthong ba'i dus su gau rī gti mug rdo rje la mchod par byed pa mos pa la sogs pa'i tshul du skye mched rnams byin gyis brlabs la longs spyod/ bsdus pa ltar na/ bdag rje btsun ma'i nga rgyal brtan pos gzugs mthong ba thams cad lha mo'i rnam pa/ sgra grag pa thams cad sngags kyi rnam par grag par bsam la longs spyad par bya'o/ /kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ni/ kha zas lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis reg la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas kha zas bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs/ snying khar lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor ram/ rje btsun ma dpa' mo cig pa nyid dam/ yi ge aṃ tsam yang lha thams cad kyi ngo bor bsam/ lte ba nas mgrin pa'i bar du me 'bar nas dbus na bzhugs pa la/ kha ni thab khung / lag pa gnyis gzar bur bsam la nang gi sbyin sreg gi mchod pa'i tshul gyis kha zas la longs spyad par bya'o/ /gtor ma dang mchod pa'i rnal 'byor rgyas pa mdun bskyed dang 'brel ba ni rje btsun yab kyi phyogs dang 'dra la/ gtor ma bsdus pa ni 'di yin te/ ji ltar 'byor pa'i yo byad mdun du bshams la/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pas bsangs la/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swā bhā wa shudho3ham̐/ zhes brjod pas stong par bsam la/ oṃ zhes brjod pas thod pa'i snod shin tu rgya che ba sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang ba dpral ba rang la bstan pa gcig bsam/ āḥzhes brjod pas nang gi rdzas rnams zhu bar bsam/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pas gang bar bsam/

de nas skad cig tsam gyis 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mgron ma lus pa spyan drangs nas phyogs bcur gang ba bzhugs par bsam/ zhes dang / thugs ka'i am̐ las 'od 'phros te de rnams la phog pas thams cad kyang bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bcu thams cad gang bar gyur/ ces brjod/ de nas lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing / oṃ a ka ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ ad+ya nut+pan+na twad oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes pa lan gsum mam bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig gis mnyes par bsam/ yang thugs ka'i am̐ las 'od 'phros mgron la phog pas mgron thams cad thig le phra mo zhig tu gyur te/ de yang je phra je phrar stong pa nyid du gyur nas mgron thams cad kyang chos dbyings su gshegs par bsams/ bdag gis bdag med ma'i bsam gtan cung zad cig dran par byas nas rdo rje'i glu/ bkra shis smon lam btab la gtor ma sa gtsang sar bskyal bar bya'o/ /nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni thun gong ma gsum la gtso mo la bsdus pa'i nga rgyal gyis spyod lam bya zhing / srod thun la khams gsum nas 'khor gyi lha mo bsdu ba'i bar na gong dang 'dra ba la/ gtso mo thugs ka'i am̐ la bsdu zhing / am̐ yang thig le la bsdu/ thig le yang je phra mi dmigs par byas la bdag med ma'i bsam gtan gyis gnyid log par bya'o/ /de nas nangs par yang lha mo bdag med ma'i nga rgyal gyis langs la thun la 'jug par bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ rdo rje 'chang dngos rje btsun sa skya pa'i/ /myur lam zab mo kun gyi snying po'i bcud/ /lnga phrag gsum ldan mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs 'di/ /tshul bzhin nyams su len la kun mkhyen nye/ /'khrul zad gong ma'i gsung rab dang 'brel zhing / /ha cang rgyas dang bsdus pa'i skyon dang bral/ /brjod bya mtha' dag rjod byed nyung ngu yis/ /rtogs pa 'di 'dra gang gis shes de mkhas/

/rtsod bral yongs 'dzin mchog gis rjes bzung zhing / /gsung rab don la dpyod pa'i blo mig gsal/ /de yang 'di na dpyod ldan thams cad kyis/ /tshad mar 'dzin pa kho bo'i rnam thar yin/ /'dir 'bad dge bas bdag dang gdul bya rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med dam chos 'phel/ /phyi ma dag pa'i zhing mchog bde ba can/ /gang der skyes nas don gnyis mthar phyin shog /ces rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i bdag nyid can gyi sgrub thabs ma nor don gsal zhes bya ba 'di ni/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po 'jam pa'i dbyangs puṇ+ya in+d+ri dang / rgyal sras sbas pa'i rnal 'byor sems dpa' chen po sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi mnga' bdag dus gsum sgrib med du gzigs pa'i rgyal ba mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams kyi zhabs sen dbang gi rgyal po spyi bo'i rgyan du bkod pa'i skal ba bzang po can sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos snyoms chung don gnyer can rnams dpe 'bri bzung bde ba'i phyir/ rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang / de'i gsal byed kun mkhyen chen pos mdzad pa'i tho yig dang / ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i gsal byed sogs dang / gzhan yang mnga' ris tshul khrims 'od zer gyis mdzad pa'i lus dkyil gyi yi ge dang / rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i dngos slob du ma'i gsung rgyun zin bris su mdzad pa'i yig cha ngo mtshar can du ma dang / snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa bstan pa'i gsal byed dam pa sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub dkyil gyi dbang chog sogs rgyas shing zhib par bstan pa'i gsung rab ngo mtshar can gyi mjug cung zad ma gsung rtsom ma rdzogs pa'i kha skong 'jam pa'i dbyangs dbang po'i mtshan can gyis mdzad pa'i yig cha sogs tshad ldan gyi gsung rab de dag la zhib tu dpyad cing dgongs don ji lta ba bzhin du bkod pa 'di ni rgya gar lugs la durma ti zhes pa blo ngan dang /

rgya nag lugs la lcags mo bya yi lo/ bai sha kha zhes pa sa ga sbrang dus kyi dmar cha bzang po gsum pa'i tshes la yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi mkha' spyod dpal gyi pho brang du sbyar ba 'dis rang gzhan la phan pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung bar gyur cig ngag 'don bde ba la dga' ba rnams dbang 'bring du len pa dang sbyar ba'i sgrub thabs shig kho bos logs na byas yod pas de bzhin nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /de ltar kho bos byas pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas bsdus dang / logs su byas pa'i dkyil chog sogs 'di rnams kyi bsgom don dang bshad pa rnams phal cher kyai rdor yab kyi skabs dang 'dra bar gsungs shing / cung zad mi 'dra ba rnams kyang rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab rnams su rgyas shing gsal bar bzhugs pas de dag la thos bsam mthar phyin pa bgyis te/ lugs 'di la bshad bsgrub gang byed kyang mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa thob pa zhig gal che ste/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi slob spring las/ cho ga'i khrigs dang gzhung tsam 'don pa la/ /sngags par rlom pa'i lugs ngan 'di dor la/ /dpyad pa gsum gyis dag pa'i rgyud sde rnams/ /yang dag rig pas tshul bzhin sgrub bar byos/ /zhes gsungs shing / chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa glo bo mkhan chen pas kyang sa skya pa'i sngags 'chang mtshan nyid pa zhig byed na/ bshad pa rgyud sde mtha' dag la mkhas pa/ nyams len man ngag rgya mtsho la dbang 'byor pa/ lag len cho ga'i cha lag phra mo bris thig dbyangs gsum tshun chad la byang chub pa zhig dgos pa yin no/ /zhes dang / mkhas pa'i dbang po rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyi gong ma'i dgongs rgyan las kyang / sngon byon gong ma'i shul lam 'di yin zhes/ /lan brgyar bshad kyang mun pa'i blo can 'ga'/ /lto chos lag len phra mo ma gtogs pa/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir mkho ba min zhes gleng / /zhes gsungs shing /
